rachats.citation: Subsequent to November 30, 2020, we acquired FONA for $710 million, which we funded with cash and commercial paper borrowings .

• On November 30, 2020, we acquired the parent company of Cholula Hot Sauce® (Cholula) from L Catterton for approximately $803 million, net of cash acquired, subject to certain customary purchase price adjustments.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
